title: Commercial result refinement
summary: Sanitized legacy authority with three logical user stories and a shared result surface.

input_assessment.summary: Stories and repository observations are present, but several decision details remain open.

exploration.stop_reason: The bounded repository inspection found the shared result surface and the remaining decision gaps.
limitations: The legacy refinement did not persist literal reconciliation responses.

sources.label: Advanced commercial filters
sources.original_text: Provide advanced filters for the commercial result.

sources.label: Filter acceptance criteria
sources.original_text: The selected commercial filters remain visible and affect the result.

sources.label: Excel export
sources.original_text: Export the current commercial result to Excel.

sources.label: Free-text search
sources.original_text: Search the commercial result with free text.

needs.title: Filter commercial results
needs.statement: A user filters commercial results by the requested structure.

needs.title: Export commercial results
needs.statement: A user exports the current commercial result to Excel.
acceptance_signals: An Excel export represents the current result.

needs.title: Search commercial results
needs.statement: A user searches commercial results with free text.

evidence.detail: The filters story requests advanced commercial filters.
The export story requests Excel output.
The search story requests free-text search.
Filter, search, and export read the same commercial result surface.

evidence.summary: A prior reconciliation decision was recorded
evidence.detail: The legacy authority records that the export result question received prior decision input; the literal response was not persisted.

relationships.title: Export depends on filters
relationships.detail: Export must represent the filtered result.

relationships.title: Filter, export, and search share results
relationships.detail: All three capabilities share the commercial result surface.

questions.question: Which advanced filters are in scope?
questions.why_material: The story and reference material must agree on the filter boundary.
questions.answer: Region and status filters are in scope.

questions.question: Which current result does Excel export represent?
questions.why_material: Export semantics depend on filters and search.

questions.question: Which fields participate in free-text search?
questions.why_material: Search behavior and matching bounds are undefined.

questions.question: Which filter controls are mandatory for the first release?
questions.why_material: The first release boundary must remain explicit across the source artifacts.
questions.answer: Region and status filters are mandatory for the first release.

constraints.statement: The exported file must represent the same commercial result visible before export.

findings.title: Advanced filter scope was ambiguous
findings.problem: The requested filters were not enumerated.
findings.why_it_matters: The commercial boundary could not be implemented consistently.
findings.impact: Filter behavior required a canonical decision.

resolution.proposal: Region and status filters are in scope.
resolution.rationale: The canonical filter boundary is explicit.

findings.title: Export result semantics remain undefined
findings.problem: The exported result does not specify its filter and search state.
findings.why_it_matters: A user can receive a misleading spreadsheet.
findings.impact: The cross-requirement export decision remains blocked.

resolution.rationale: The legacy decision did not establish the exact result state contract.
resolution.remaining_gap: The exported result must identify the exact filter and search state.

findings.title: Free-text search scope is undefined
findings.problem: Search fields and matching behavior are absent.

final_assessment.rationale: Three capabilities share a technical surface and have a directional dependency.

handoff.reason: Two open BLOCKING findings require reconciliation.
